en: A black‑and‑white postcard view of a sparsely developed industrial settlement in a hilly, forested landscape. A dirt road curves through the foreground where a solitary man stands facing the camera. In the middle distance there is a cluster of long, wooden industrial and residential buildings with simple gabled roofs, some on stilts or scaffolding as if under construction. Tall bare poles, possibly for power or telegraph lines, stand among the buildings. Coniferous forest and low hills form the background. At the top left there is printed text in a Scandinavian language.
